newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunker final report and prices- Nov 14.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunker final report and prices- Nov 14.

text.p: DELIVERED U.S.$/TONNE) 380 CST 180 CST MDO GAS OIL

COMMENTS - Bunker prices were unchanged despite crude gains. Sellers, trying to attract shipowners did not raise offers. But after Tuesday's spate of heavy buying, shipowners inventories were high and they will not emerge because prices are too expensive, traders said. One independent sold a 180-cst parcel at $125.50 a tonne ex-wharf and 380-cst at $120. MDO and gasoil were firmer, tracking higher gas oil cargo prices.
